purpose: Teach: スナップ/ソックス/メッシュ/１番/合コン/酔っ払っ/愛嬌/おしっこ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスナップ写真を上手に撮って下さるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is really good at taking candid photos.
lines.style: Warm and reflective. Soft smile in the voice. Noticing something good about him. Gentle pace, like she's sharing a quiet observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからソックスを頂いたよ
lines.style: Bright and earnest. Small voice full of pride in the ordinary gift. Direct, unperformed. The simplicity of a six-year-old who thinks this matters and knows it does.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメッシュのバッグを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave me a mesh bag.
lines.style: Tender and matter-of-fact. No fanfare. Soft pause between clauses. The warmth of someone noticing and naming small kindnesses.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「１番は健康」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that health comes first.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Careful pronunciation, like he's holding the lesson close. Earnest without being stiff. The seriousness of a child who understands this was important to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「合コンより家族の時間」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said family time matters more than anything else.
lines.style: Reflective and warm. Slight lift on the emphasis—not preachy, just settling into agreement. Noticing what he values. Pace unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「酔っ払った人には近付かない」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me never to get close to someone who's drunk.
lines.style: Steady and earnest. Small voice, no lightness. The seriousness of a child relaying a safety lesson he understands. Direct and careful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「愛嬌のある人になれ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said to become someone people are drawn to.
lines.style: Reflective. Slight warmth on the word 'charm.' Speaking as if she's understood something about what he values in people. Gentle, not loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「おしっこは早めに」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me to go to the bathroom early.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact close. Small, sincere voice. No self-consciousness about the practical wisdom. The gentle humor of a child taking seriously what an adult has taken seriously.
